Name: Joja's Dark Secret
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[center][size=4][b]1st Place in the Showstopper category![/b][/size]
[img]https://imgur.com/DIZVDa5.png[/img]﻿﻿
[size=3](credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120958053]elizabeth[/url] for the lovely art!)[/size]


[img]https://imgur.com/bnoZ5d6.png[/img]
﻿﻿[/center]
Discover a mysterious conspiracy unfolding beneath Pelican Town's streets... I made this mod in about 24 hours for the 2023 Halloween Mod Jam on the Stardew Valley Discord server and I hope you enjoy! I have more content I'd like to add so if time permits, there will be updates in the future :)

[size=5][b][color=#00FF7F]Installation[/color][/b][/size][size=1]
﻿[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[/list]

[size=5][b][color=#00FF7F]Documentation[/color][/b][/size][size=1]

[/size]New in this update, there is a config option, Letter Random Chance. If enabled, you will receive the initial letter at a random time after obtaining the Rusty Key. If disabled, you will receive the letter immediately after obtaining the Rusty Key. Once the letter has been received, follow the instructions to trigger the event!
For best results, full-screen the game and set your Lighting Quality to High. Enjoy!


[size=5][b][color=#00FF7F]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size][size=1]
﻿[/size][list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Windows. Linux/Mac have not been tested but should work. Earlier versions have not been tested but should work. Please report any issues you encounter.
[*]Works in single player and multiplayer.
[/list]
